messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty triggered: SEV2 - Okta /introspect returning 5xx -> console login failures for a subset of customers :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Paging team 'oncall-auth' (Alex P) and escalation to second (Sara L)
Alex P: I'm on it — seeing a spike of 502s from Okta's introspect endpoint from our auth middleware. Console logins failing with 401s when middleware calls introspect.
Sara L: adding context — mobile refresh flows also showing errors; some API requests using opaque tokens still work if the token TTL hasn't required introspect yet.
Jordan K: Can you paste an example curl response from the introspect endpoint?
Alex P: pasted below, from one of our failed calls:
```
curl -X POST https://dev-12345.okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect -d 'token=abc' -H 'Authorization: Basic REDACTED'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"server_error","error_description":"Upstream failed to respond"}
```
Ria C: Confirming logs in auth-proxy show 502s and 504s between 2024-08-10T13:05 and +15m. Rate didn't look abnormal — looks like Okta upstream degradation.
Support Bot: Customer impact triage: Some customers report "Cannot sign in" on Console. SSO via Okta affected for Console; API token auth still succeeding for most backend services. Churned support tickets: 12 incoming, 3 escalations.
Alex P: Mitigation options we can take now:
- A: Increase local cache TTL for jwks and allow JWT verification for tokens that contain a kid we have cached (fast, low risk internally).
- B: Flip bypass_introspect feature flag for internal console routes so we accept cached jwks-verified tokens for 30m (requires feature toggle deploy).
- C: Route introspect calls to Okta cluster fallback endpoints if available (we have a secondary base URL configured in secrets but not wired).
Sara L: I can deploy the feature flag (B) quickly from the console if we agree — it only affects /console route and requires a config flip + small hot-restart. Risks: may accept tokens that have been revoked but Okta introspect is the revocation guard. We should limit to internal employees and org-admins?
Jordan K: Suggest limiting to customer support/admin console only, not customer-facing login. That reduces blast radius.
Alex P: Agreed. Plan: 1) Enable bypass_introspect for /console-admin and /support-console only. 2) Increase jwks cache TTL from 5m -> 30m. 3) Open Okta ticket (we have support P1) and monitor.
Oncall Rotation: Alex, want to handoff after initial mitigations? I can take followups and customer comms.
Alex P: I'll implement steps 1+2 now and then hand to Ria for monitoring. Pushing patch to feature flags -> rolling restart for console workers.
Ops Bot: Running deployment: feature-flag toggle 'auth.bypass_introspect_console' -> true
Alex P: Patch applied. Restarting 3x console pods with rolling window 3m.
Ria C: Pods restarted. Confirming 200s for login paths that previously 401ed, after bypass. Seeing successful token validation via local JWKS for ~80% of previously failing requests.
Support Bot: Notifying customers: Draft message to affected customers ready — suggests "We are seeing intermittent third-party identity provider errors; we have applied a temporary mitigation so console access should be restored; full verification will resume once Okta recovers." Approve? :eyes:
Jordan K: Approve. Add note about risk of token revocation not being enforced during mitigation window.
PagerDuty: Acknowledged. Incident severity remains SEV2 while mitigation is active and root cause unresolved.
Alex P: Okta support case opened: CASE-987654. They acknowledged a partial outage in the US region affecting token introspect. Working with their engineering.
Ria C: Monitoring: 502 rate from Okta has dropped but is still non-zero. Our error rate to introspect down from 12% -> 1.8% after the bypass. Customer tickets reduced.
Sara L: Next actions: keep bypass for up to 2 hours, monitor for revoked token abuse (we ran a quick scan for recent revocations — none relevant), wait for Okta to resolve. If Okta provides fix, we'll re-enable introspect and revert TTL.
Oncall Rotation: I'm taking over the incident for shift. Handoff notes: mitigation applied (bypass flag scope: /console-admin,/support-console), jwks TTL set to 30m, Okta case open CASE-987654, support notified, monitoring dash pinned.
Alex P: Handing off to Ria/Jordan for customer comms and continued monitoring. I'll be available on DM.
Ria C: Posting status update to status page draft: "Partial login disruption affecting console logins via Okta for a subset of customers. Temporary mitigation applied; impact reduced. Investigating with Okta."
Support Bot: Sent initial customer notices via status page and support channels.
Incident Bot: Reminder: If Okta does a config rollout, we may see additional flapping — keep retries/backoff aggressive in middleware.
Jordan K: After 35m, Okta reports "service recovered" in their status and their introspect 200s resumed. We should plan controlled revert.
Ria C: Rolling revert: set jwks TTL back to 5m, disable bypass flag, restart console pods gracefully.
Ops Bot: Revert applied. Feature flag 'auth.bypass_introspect_console' -> false. Pods restarted.
Alex P: Post-revert validation: introspect 200s, and console login flows healthy. No new customer escalations.
Support Bot: Final impact summary: ~12 customers reported issues, ~3 escalations, ~30m total degraded period for majority; mitigation restored access for most within 10m of mitigation.
PagerDuty: Incident moved to postmortem queue — assign to Alex P + Ria C for write-up.
Alex P: I'll draft the postmortem with timeline, mitigation, follow-ups: add a follow-up to wire fallback introspect endpoints in config and add automated detection for introspect 5xx > 5% -> auto-bypass (with audit).
Ria C: Also add runbook update: explicit section for third-party idp outages, and a communication template for support.
Jordan K: Thanks everyone. Closing on-call handover. I'll keep monitoring for 1h then close thread. :thumbsup:
